item.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission reviewed police investigations into force used against a child in State care and the preparation of officers' court evidence.
item.support: The criminal investigation considered whether the child had been assaulted and whether the involved officers had attempted to pervert the course of justice.

item.text: The Commission considered the reasoning against an assault charge inconsistent with the disciplinary findings and believed criminal proceedings should have been brought, while WA Police disagreed.
item.support: In the Commission's opinion, the investigation did fail and criminal proceedings for assault should have been instituted.

item.text: The Commission accepted that the decision against charges for attempting to pervert justice was open to the police investigator.
item.support: the conclusion by the investigating officer that there was insufficient evidence to support charges of attempting to pervert the course of justice was reasonably open.

item.text: Apart from the disagreement about assault, the Commission concluded that WA Police had handled the matter appropriately and completed its review.
item.support: the WA Police Force has otherwise dealt with the matter appropriately and reached conclusions that are open.

item.quote: In the Commission's opinion, the investigation did fail and criminal proceedings for assault should have been instituted.
